verdict.rationale: The open-source Whisper CLI accepts several audio files in one command (`whisper audio.flac audio.mp3 audio.wav --model turbo`), so it does support basic multi-item batch transcription. The hosted API and its CLI example are documented only for one file per request, with a 25 MB per-file limit. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/batch endpoint for the hosted API, guidance on batching at scale (concurrency, progress, failure handling), bulk operations beyond transcription, and independent corroboration of multi-file batch use.
